name: Citizenship by Investment (CBI)

requirements.blocker_text: Non-refundable contribution of at least US$150,000 to the National Transformation Fund.
requirements.fix_path: Make the qualifying National Transformation Fund contribution.

requirements.blocker_text: Main applicant must be at least 18 years old.
Purchase of a qualifying share in a government-approved real estate development (from the official List of Approved Projects).
requirements.fix_path: Purchase a qualifying share in an approved real estate project.

requirements.blocker_text: Third-party sources cite a minimum of approximately US$270,000 for the real estate option, though this figure is not confirmed on the official CBI site itself.

evidence_required.document: Due diligence fees (up to ~US$15,620 for a family, per third-party estimate)

sources.title: Citizenship by Investment Committee, Government of Grenada -- Official CBI site: National Transformation Fund (minimum US$150,000 contribution) and Real Estate Options (Approved Projects, exact minimum not stated on this page), 3-4 month processing
Osher Advisors -- cites a real-estate CBI minimum of US$270,000 and due-diligence fees up to ~US$15,620 for a family, figures not independently confirmed on the official cbi.gov.gd site

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Grenada's initial build. IMPORTANT DISCREPANCY: the official cbi.gov.gd site states the National Transformation Fund minimum as US$150,000 without breaking out per-dependent add-ons, while a tier-3 source (osheradvisors.com) cites a considerably higher $235,000 figure for the same NTF route and $270,000 for real estate -- these may reflect a family-inclusive total, a 2024/2025 fee increase not yet reflected on the official page, or simply inconsistent secondary reporting. This build models the confirmed tier-1 figure ($150,000) as the hard NTF requirement rather than guessing which secondary figure is more current; the real-estate dollar threshold is NOT tier-1 confirmed at all, so it is modelled as hard: false (informational only) while the existence of the real-estate option itself IS tier-1 confirmed and kept hard: true. Per-group age requirements set to hard: false per this session's established CBI convention. Re-verify current NTF and real-estate figures directly against cbi.gov.gd's linked Schedule of Fees before relying on this for a live application.
